topics.title: Stern & Robin Discuss Disturbing Attack and Racial Incidents
topics.summary: Howard and Robin discuss a recent attack on two black children by white teenagers who sprayed them with an unidentified substance. They then explore broader racial violence, referencing personal experiences and suggesting similar incidents occur within the Black community as well.

topics.title: Denny Terrio’s Account of Murph Griffin Show
topics.summary: During a radio interview, Denny Terrio recounts his experience appearing on the Murph Griffin show after being approached for dancing at Caesar's Palace. The conversation shifts to allegations involving inappropriate behavior fueled by claims from women who lived with him and ultimately led to legal action.

topics.title: Merv Griffin and Denny Tarrio Discuss Sexual Harassment
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard Stern facilitates a conversation between Merv Griffin and two guests, Denny Tarrio and Richard Simmons, regarding allegations that Merv made unwanted advances toward Denny during a TV show pilot meeting. The discussion centers around uncomfortable interactions including Simmons’ appearance in bikini underwear.

topics.title: Denny’s Hotel Encounter
topics.summary: During an interview, Denny recounts a bizarre encounter with Merv Griffin involving unwanted advances and accusations.
